message.content: A kanban board is a visual workflow management tool—typically a set of columns (e.g., "To Do," "In Progress," "Done") with cards representing individual tasks—used to visualize work, limit work-in-progress, and manage flow through a process.
message.reasoning_content: The user asks for a one-sentence definition of a kanban board. This is a straightforward factual question I can answer from knowledge. A kanban board is a visual workflow management tool (originally from Toyota's manufacturing system) that displays work items in columns representing stages of a process (e.g., To Do, In Progress, Done) to visualize and manage workflow.
